items.title: Record missed-event recovery gaps after outages beyond the polling lookback
items.problem: Open report captured 2026-10-03 during execution reconciliation. Another code-quality task may own an active fix; inspect its PR and current source before dispatch.
acceptance: Read the linked issue and current default branch; classify the exact defect, current owner and evidence gap.
Record a current PR or verified resolution before selecting any implementation; preserve broader feature and live acceptance gates.
validation: Read current issue and PR state using nathanmcnulty; do not modify or close issues during reconciliation.
Inspect dirty state and worktrees; resolve the exact current revision and relevant offline commands before implementation.
evidence: Issue #16 is closed by merged PR #17, whose merge commit is current main c12b1aa70c409df7d57ddd4af5587c305523d7c9. Source now persists the last fully successful query watermark, replays with bounded overlap for up to 24 hours, retains explicit recovery gaps and stops before active deduplication IDs would be evicted.

PR #17 reported 121 Pester and 19 Node tests plus offline validator, Bicep/schema and audit checks. This reconciliation reruns current-main offline validation; no hosted outage, Graph mutation or downstream delivery is claimed.
